_comment: Lesson 28: the reactive chain built and paused mid-playback. A sound file feeds an RMS envelope, a signal display draws the reading over the waveform, a micromap scales it, and the result drives the zoom parameter of an ISF shader whose rendered output is previewed in the inspector. Badges match walkthrough steps 2 (the envelope), 4 (the reading on the signal display), 5 (the scaling stage), and 6 (the image it drives).
